A fast-moving white pick-up truck violates a blinking red light and drives straight into the intersection, triggering a chain of violent collisions. The truck first T-bones a silver SUV and a silver sedan, causing the truck to deflect and collide head-on with a stationary white truck in lane 2. Simultaneously, the silver SUV is flipped by the impact, overturning onto a stationary black SUV and a black hatchback in lanes 3 and 4. The force of these collisions causes the black SUV to drift backward and rear-end a stationary white sedan, while the silver sedan sustains severe damage and catches fire. The root cause is the white pick-up truck driver's failure to stop for the blinking red signal, which created an unavoidable multi-vehicle pileup.

A blue sedan loses control and speeds into a gas station forecourt, striking a pedestrian in a yellow high-visibility outfit in a head-on collision before crashing directly into a fuel filling unit. The impact knocks over the pump and destroys it, causing an immediate and catastrophic fire to break out. The root cause of the incident is the driver's failure to maintain control of the vehicle and the decision to enter a pedestrian and fueling zone at an unsafe speed, making the collisions unavoidable.
